findings.claim: Fully filtered snapshots still issue a completion checkpoint at `None`, causing resume to seek `Offset::BEGINNING` instead of the required pre-snapshot position.
findings.evidence: The prior resolution states an empty/fully filtered snapshot must keep its completion checkpoint at the pre-snapshot position; however `snapshot_frames` sets `completion_offset = if authorized.is_empty() { None } else { cursor.as_ref().map(|value| value.broker_offset) }`, and the resume path maps `None` to `Offset::BEGINNING` with `let from = offset.map_or(Offset::BEGINNING, |value| Offset(value).next());`.
findings.suggested_fix: For a fully filtered snapshot, compute and checkpoint the offset immediately before the earliest in-scope undisclosed row (or another actual pre-snapshot retained boundary), rather than always using `None`; only use `None` when that boundary is truly before broker offset 0.
